mentions.name: Keyboard-only font drawing app
mentions.description: A keyboard-only font drawing app inspired by vim, used to draw typeface glyphs and export them as TTF font files.
mentions.source_excerpt: I’ve been working on a fontdrawing app that only uses the keyboard (inspired by vim) for a couple of months. Finally got export to ttf working this weekend and got to see a bad looking j I drew in Figma
